name: Halari Restaurant
signature_dish: Jadoh (Khasi rice cooked in pork blood and spices)
why_it_matters: One of the few Sohra restaurants that still cooks traditional Khasi staples to order rather than swapping them out for the safer Indian-Chinese menu most tourists default to.
insider_tip: Ask for jadoh with pork — the menu lists Indian dishes first, but the kitchen does the Khasi line better. Closes sharp 8.30pm.
signature_address: Saitsohpen Junction (three-road intersection, Lower Sohra), East Khasi Hills, Meghalaya 793108

name: Taste of Tawang
signature_dish: Shirkyong-pa with Tingmo (Monpa stew with steamed bread)
why_it_matters: Run by a group of sisters cooking actual Monpa home recipes — zan, churpi, shirkyong-pa — not the generic Tibetan-Chinese menu every other Tawang kitchen prints.
insider_tip: Order the chilli paneer with their red chilli chutney — even the meat-eaters take it home. Cash only, signal patchy for UPI.
signature_address: Old Market, Tawang, Tawang District, Arunachal Pradesh 790104

name: Zostel Chitkul Cafe
signature_dish: Stuffed paratha breakfast with apple compote
why_it_matters: Open-air deck cafe attached to Zostel that the chef runs as a near-public kitchen — the only place in Chitkul that reliably serves a hot brunch with a Baspa-valley view and accepts walk-ins from non-residents through the day.
insider_tip: Sit on the outdoor deck — indoor seating is cramped. December-March cafe operates limited hours when only the hostel is open. Cash preferred; UPI patchy.
signature_address: Zostel Chitkul, Chitkul Village, Sangla Tehsil, Kinnaur District, Himachal Pradesh 172106

name: The Wanderer's Nest Restaurant
why_it_matters: A homestay kitchen run by a Nepali cook who works without excess oil or masala — the only place in Chitkul where you can ask for less spice and actually get it. Walk-in for outsiders is allowed when rooms aren't full.
insider_tip: Call ahead between 11am-3pm to confirm the kitchen is open to non-residents. Madra needs 30-min lead time.
signature_address: Chitkul Village, Sangla Tehsil, Kinnaur District, Himachal Pradesh 172106
